findings.suggested: Non lu à voix haute (son coupé)
findings.reason: 'Non lu' is the settled French UI word for 'unread' (ui.community.rail.unread, mark_unread, hold.unread_mail). Alone it reads as 'unread message' and loses the 'spoken aloud' sense that summary_label/spoken_part_note carry. The parenthetical lowers the risk, so MINOR. Fix lengthens 18 to 31 chars, still shorter than summary_stopped.

Every shipped fr string, including the whole voice namespace and ui.chat.ask_queue.reason_answered_in_chat, calls the chat 'conversation'. The only fr-corpus use of 'chat' as a noun is this key. +8 chars; 'ci-dessus' is not a fit because this link sits in the History row, where 'above' would be ambiguous.
'À lire à voix haute' can read as an instruction to the user ('to read aloud'). The context note is future tense, and the voice does the reading. Same length (19 vs 20). Acceptable as is.
